public_art.title: Sumer #24
public_art.access: artwork is available from 8 am - 6 pm
public_art.detail: Larry Bell, born in 1939 in Chicago and associated with the Light and Space movement, cast Sumer #24 in bronze as part of a series referencing the ancient civilization of Sumer.

public_art.detail: Charles Arnoldi, an American painter, sculptor and printmaker, was born in 1946 in Dayton, Ohio, and had his first solo exhibition at Los Angeles's Riko Mizuno Gallery in 1971.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: A transitional downtown tower by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill: a return to the glass and steel curtain wall of Miesian corporate Modernism, but with white stone panelling at the base and part of the tower - a material closer to Postmodern corporate design and to compliance with the 1971 Urban Design Plan and 1985 Downtown Plan.
